actions.action: Plant the seed with roots buried about 2 cm deep, seed half-buried, shoot up
Poke 3-4 drainage holes in the cup bottom if it has none
Move to bright indirect light for the first week, then allow morning sun
Check soil moisture with a finger every 2-3 days and water until it drains when the top 1 cm is dry
Watch whether the tip blackens and wait for a new shoot from the seed
